title: Earthy Kenyan Celery Stew
description: A resinous and molten Kenyan dish featuring celery, this stew is a cozy delight, simmered to perfection in a nimono style and free from added sugars, making it suitable for sugar-free diets.
instructions: Heat oil in a pan over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger and cook for another minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped celery and cook until it starts to soften.
Pour in the beef broth, coconut milk, turmeric, cumin, salt, and black pepper, and stir well to combine.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 20 minutes.
Use an immersion blender to puree the stew to the desired consistency, or leave it chunky if preferred.
Taste and adjust the seasoning as needed.
Ladle the stew into individual mini cocottes and serve hot.
Garnish with chopped fresh herbs, if desired.
